messages:
alex rogers: Morning — quick heads-up: running kb link-scan on runtime guide and found ~12 dead links (images + 3 external api references). I'm going to batch minor fixes into one PR, but need owners for a couple pages before I push. pinging @maria @jordan
maria chen: thanks — can you paste the scan output? I can take runtime/serving/* pages today.
jordan li: I can own model-onboarding and runtime-ops pages. @alex do you want me to open the PR or do you prefer a single PR with all small fixes?
alex rogers: single PR is fine. prefer smaller commits grouped by subtree. include one commit per fix type (image rehost, external url swap, anchor fix). also add a short changelog line in frontmatter if you change any canonical URLs. :+1:
docs-bot: link-scan results uploaded: https://internal.kb/reports/scan-7991234567 — summary: 12 dead links, 4 403s, 3 external 404s, 5 image 403s
samira: rehosting images — quick sed command I use to update paths locally:
```
sed -n 's#/old-cdn/#/rehosted-cdn/#g' -i runtime/**/*.md
```
samira: after updating images I push to staging and run the preview job: `./scripts/kb-preview.sh runtime` — staging URL shows inline images now.
jordan li: ok I've claimed runtime/model-onboarding and runtime/ops. will do content-only fixes (no frontmatter) and tag @maria for review.
maria chen: i'll take runtime/serving and runtime/caching. will try to batch the external api swaps and add redirect notes.
alex rogers: tiny ask — if you change any anchor ids, add a short redirect in the frontmatter `redirect_from:` so search picks it up. also, can someone add the new nightly link-scan to the docs CI? even a lightweight check that fails the PR if new 404s are introduced.
maria chen: I can add a GH Action snippet in my PR. sample: `uses: redwood/actions/link-scan@v1` and a check step.
jordan li: pinging @eng-infra to see if we should gate the repo-level action or put it per-PR. @samira any objections to me opening the PR now? 
samira: no objections. go ahead. maybe add `[ci skip]` to commit message only if you're doing WIP, otherwise let the action run.
alex rogers: perfect — thank you. timeline: hope to merge small fixes by EOD so we can re-run the global crawl tomorrow morning. i'll post the merged PR link here once done. :rocket:
